source: Independent accumulator and bounded/iterative traversal implementation informed by the clsx API and tests. No upstream runtime is included; the MIT license, type contract and unchanged tests retain attribution.
scope: Full and lite conditional class names used directly in VentiMath components and by MUI. Native ESM and CommonJS on Node 24/Bun; browser bundling and native ESM entry. UMD global builds are not provided.

implementation.targetScope: Conditional strings, numbers, dictionaries and nested arrays; string-only lite entry.

changes: Only own enumerable truthy dictionary fields become classes; inherited fields are intentionally excluded.
A bounded fast traversal switches to explicit frames for deep arrays; cycles throw a deterministic TypeError while shared subarrays remain valid.
Readonly nested arrays are accepted by the declarations; CJS and native ESM share function identities.
